subject: sounds
title: Count the sounds
about: Hear a word, say each sound, and tap how many sounds it has (two to five). This is NC RF.1.3.d, segmenting a word into all its sounds, which is exactly what the DIBELS PSF test measures.
tip: Have him say the sounds out loud and hold up one finger per sound before he taps the number.

cards.sayQ: How many sounds do you hear in up? up.
